title: Eclampsia (seizure)
summary: Convulsive seizure in pregnancy, labour, or postnatally in a woman with or without known pre-eclampsia.

blocks.heading: Actions
bullets: Call 2222 / emergency obstetric call per local protocol; call 999 if outside a hospital setting.
Protect from injury; do not restrain; place in left lateral position once seizure allows; maintain airway.

Magnesium sulfate is the treatment of choice for seizure control and prevention of further seizures — administer per local protocol/PGD. VERIFY exact dose and regimen against current local guideline before giving.
Control severe hypertension per local antihypertensive protocol if BP ≥160/110 mmHg — VERIFY agent and dose locally.
Continuous fetal and maternal monitoring once safe to apply.
Plan for birth once mother stabilised — timing is an obstetric decision, not delayed for convenience.
Strict fluid balance — avoid fluid overload (risk of pulmonary oedema).

blocks.heading: What to document
bullets: Time help called and team members present.
Magnesium sulfate — dose, route, time given.
BP readings and antihypertensive given if applicable.
